quality_policy: No primitive placeholder may be marked production_ready. Imported GLB files are structurally checked; accepted assets require source, license, PBR textures and profile-specific geometry.
import_standard: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), metres, Y-up conversion handled by Godot importer, embedded textures, named nodes, mobile LODs, collision meshes separated from render meshes.
